scenario: A completion reply claims a report-download feature is ready. Branch code covers the design criteria, but the project's build command actually exits 1 with a missing import in the new report module.
expect: Records the build command failure and missing-import output
Reports verdict needs_work instead of trusting the reply
Keeps criterion evidence separate from the failing check
Names the blocking build failure in the contract-resolved {out.verification} artifact (currently verify-changes.md)

scenario: A documentation-only branch updates the exact two migration sections requested by the ticket. Neither design.md nor tasks.yaml exists, and project inspection finds no test lint or build commands.
expect: Derives the checklist from the ticket outcome
Cites both concrete documentation diff changes
Explicitly records that project checks are absent rather than claiming they passed
Writes verification evidence and bases the verdict on the evidenced ticket requirements
